Regular City Council Meeting
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS CITY COUNCIL
1245 North Hacienda Road
La Habra Heights, California
4:30 p.m. Closed Session
06:00 p.m. Regular Business
July 11, 2013
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
The City Council will listen to the public on any numbered item on the agenda or any item that is not on the agenda but relevant to City business. The City Council cannot legally take action on any item not scheduled on the agenda. Such items may be referred for administrative action or scheduled on a future agenda. If you wish to speak to the Council, please complete a Speaker's Card and present it before the agenda item is called. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak to the Council. Should you need to provide written documentation to the City, please give the City Manager a minimum of nine (9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed appropriately. Comments will generally be limited to three minutes per speaker. However, a shorter limit may be declared by the Mayor for agenda items for which many Speaker Cards have been submitted.
Public Comment For Items On The Agenda: Speakers will be called on in the order cards were received.
Public Comment For Items Not On The Agenda: Persons wishing to speak on agenda items will be called at the time the agenda item is brought forward.

MINUTES

  City of La Habra Heights
  Regular Meeting of the La Habra Heights City Council
  July 11, 2013

Call to Order – Regular City Council Meeting

1.  Call Meeting to Order – At 4:35 p.m., Mayor Francis called the Regular City
  Council Meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Mayor Roy Francis, Mayor Pro Tempore Brian Bergman, Council Members Kyle
Miller, and Jane Williams.

Also Present: Holly O. Whatley and City Attorney; Shauna Clark, City Manager; Gabriella
Yap, Assistant City Manager; Doug Graft, Fire Chief; Sandra Studer, Deputy City Clerk;
Grace Andres, Deputy City Clerk.

Absent: Council Member Michael Higgins

3.  Public Comments on the following agenda item:

Closed Session

At 4:36 p.m., the City Council, City Manager, and City Attorney adjourned to closed
session on the following:

Conference with Legal Counsel

The City Council finds, based on advice from legal counsel, that discussion in open
session will prejudice the position of the local agency in the litigation.

Existing Litigation: G.C. 54956.9(a)
Morgan v. City of La Habra Heights, LASC Case #BS137685

Anticipated Litigation (G.C. 54956.9(d)(2))

Regular City Council Meeting  1  July 11, 2013
Minutes
 Present: Mayor Roy Francis, Mayor Pro Tempore Brian Bergman, Council Members Kyle
Miller, and Jane Williams; Holly O. Whatley, City Attorney; and Shauna Clark, City
Manager.

It was noted that Council Member Higgins arrived at the meeting at the hour of 4:53 p.m.

At 5:55 p.m., Closed Session ended.

Opening Ceremonies

Regular Business

1.  Call Meeting to Order – At 6:07 p.m., Mayor Francis reconvened the Regular City
  Council Meeting.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Mayor Roy Francis, Mayor Pro Tempore Brian Bergman, Council Members
Michael Higgins, Kyle Miller, and Jane Williams.

Also Present: Holly O. Whatley, City Attorney; Shauna Clark, City Manager; Gabriella
Yap, Assistant City Manager; Rochelle Clayton, Finance Manager; Doug Graft, Fire Chief;
Lieutenant Michael Strickland, Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department; Dave Nichols,
Public Works Manager; Sandra Studer, Deputy City Clerk; and Grace Andres, Deputy City
Clerk.

3.  Flag Salute – Council Member Williams led those assembled in the Pledge of
  Allegiance.

Statement from Closed Session: City Attorney Whatley reported that for the first Closed
Session item, Morgan vs. City of La Habra Heights the City Council took action on a vote
of 5-0 to approve a settlement to waive the City’s right to appeal in exchange for a
reduction in the claim against the City for a memorandum of costs associated with the
lawsuit. City Attorney Whatley reported there was no reportable action for the second item.

4.  Presentations

  A. Jack Sayler - Outgoing Planning Commissioner.
  B. Joe Geissinger - Certificate of Appreciation for his years of service to the City.

5.  Public Comments

6.  Administrative Reports
  A.  City Manager’s Report
  B.  City Attorney’s Report
  C.  Community Development Report
  D.  Fire Chief’s Report
  E.  Sheriff’s Department Report

Regular City Council Meeting  2  July 11, 2013
Minutes
 Consent Calendar

Action: Moved (Bergman), seconded (Williams), and carried unanimously to approve
consent agenda items 8, 9, 10, 13, and 14.

8.  Treasurer's Report for May 2013

9.  Minutes of June 13, 2013 – Regular Meeting

10.  Minutes of June 27, 2013 – Special City Council Meeting

13.  Agreement with City of La Habra for Vehicle Maintenance and Repairs -
  Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement, in a form approved by the
  City Attorney, with the City of La Habra to provide vehicle maintenance and repair
  services for the City of La Habra Heights.

14.  Writ of Mandamus Issued In Morgan V. City of La Habra Heights Case –
  Approve Resolution 2013-11, rescinding Resolution 2012-03.

  Resolution 2013-11: A Resolution of the City Council of the City of La Habra
  Heights, County of Los Angeles, State of California, rescinding Resolution 2012-03.

Consent Calendar – Items pulled for review

7.  Warrant Register for June 2013

Action: Moved (Williams), seconded (Francis) and carried unanimously to approve.

11.  Minutes of July 2, 2013 – A Joint Training Session of the La Habra Heights
  City Council and Planning Commission: AB1234 Training

Action: Moved (Miller), seconded (Williams) and carried unanimously to approve the
minutes as amended to include the information that Mayor Francis had announced at the
meeting that the meeting had not been filmed upon his direction.

12.  Fiscal Year 2011-12 Annual Financial Audit – Diehl, Evans and Company, LLP

Action: Following discussion, moved (Francis), seconded (Miller) and approved
unanimously to receive and file.

  -------------------------------- END OF CONSENT CALENDAR --------------------------------

Regular City Council Meeting  3  July 11, 2013
Minutes
 Public Hearing

15.  Hearing on Report and Assessment of Weed Abatement Fees Past Due

Resolution 2013-12: A Resolution of the City Council of the City of La Habra Heights
confirming a report of costs incurred in connection with the City’s Weed Abatement
Program; confirming the assessments and liens set forth in such report; and directing that
such assessments be collected on the property tax roll

Mayor Francis opened the public hearing.

Noting no protests, Mayor Francis closed the public hearing.

Action: Moved (Bergman), seconded (Higgins) and carried unanimously to remove 1905
Kanola Road (APN 8266-014-011) from the itemized Written Report of Weed Abatement
Costs and adopt Resolution 2013-12.

16.  Congestion Management Program (CMP) Self-Certification

Resolution 2013-13: A Resolution of the City of La Habra Heights, California, finding the
City to be in conformance with the Congestion Management Program (CMP) and adopting
the CMP Local Development Report, in accordance with California Government Code
Section 65089.

Mayor Francis opened the public hearing.

Noting no speakers, Mayor Francis closed the public hearing.

Action: Moved (Miller), seconded (Higgins) and carried unanimously to approve
Resolution 2013-13 finding the City to be in conformance with the Congestion
Management Program (CMP) and adopting the Local Development Report (LDR) and
directed staff to forward Resolution 2013-13 and Self Certification Plan to the Los Angeles
County Metropolitan Transit Authority.

  -------------------------------- END OF PUBLIC HEARING --------------------------------

Administrative Items

17.  Authorization to Solicit Bids From Pre-Qualified Contractors for the
  Renovation of City Hall (Continued from 06-13-2013)

Action: Moved (Miller), seconded (Williams) and carried unanimously to authorize staff to
invite pre-qualified contractors to prepare and submit proposals.

18.  City Hall Water Service Provider (Continued from 06-13-2013)

Council Member Higgins recused himself and left the room.

Regular City Council Meeting  4  July 11, 2013
Minutes
 Action: Moved (Williams), seconded (Francis) and carried on a vote of 4-0 (recused
Higgins) to authorize the City Manager to transition service from California Domestic Water
Company to La Habra Heights County Water District, including paying for installation to be
funded by the General Fund.

19.  2013 Competitive Trails Grant Program

Action: Moved (Williams), seconded (Francis) and carried unanimously to receive and file
the report.

  -------------------------------- END OF ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS --------------------------------

20.  Public Comments on Items Not On the Agenda

City Council Comments

Requested by: There was Council consensus to hold a joint session of the Planning
Commission and City Council for a study session to discuss Municipal Code revisions and
direct staff to schedule a meeting in the future.

Requested by: Mayor Francis requested Council’s consideration of changing the October
10th Regular City Council meeting to October 9th.

Adjournment – At 7:58 p.m. on July 11, 2013 Mayor Francis adjourned the meeting.

Submitted for Council Approval:

Sandra Studer
______________________________
Sandra Studer, Deputy City Clerk

Regular City Council Meeting  5  July 11, 2013
Minutes
